patterns.title: Double Standard Technique
patterns.short_description: Apply the same fair, compassionate standard to yourself that you apply to someone you care about.
use_when: Self-criticism is harsher than your judgment of others.
Illness or limited capacity triggers global judgments about your worth.
A mistake becomes a verdict on your whole character.
example_user_queries: I am much harder on myself than on other people.
I feel useless when I cannot get things done.
I keep blaming myself for needing rest.
One mistake makes me feel like a complete failure.
I can support my friends but cannot support myself.
Being kind to myself feels like making excuses.
I know what I would tell a friend, but it does not apply to me.
I feel guilty because I cannot do as much while I am ill.

visual_decision.reason: The examples convey the comparison without a diagram.

patterns.practice_format: Four grouped Pattern Language steps with optional answers and belief ratings; original self-guided adaptation.
